titleText.es: Excelente recuperación... ¡algo que podríamos usar para salvar a tu primer hermano de alguna manera!
titleText.en: Excellent recovery: ... which we could try to use to somehow save your original brother!
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish archive and official xkcd source both identify comic #660. The Spanish title text translates the official afterthought while changing “original brother” to primer hermano. The raster restores MURIÓ and CORAZÓN accents and joins the visible line-broken words SENTÍ, ACORDE, and VELOCIDAD.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Here simpatía is fellow-feeling for someone in pain, not simply friendliness.

example.en: She showed sympathy for the family.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: no separate English word; links a time noun to que
cardDefinitions.noteEn: In a connector such as el momento en que, en que works like “when” or “in which.”

example.es: Recuerdo el día en que llegó.
example.en: I remember the day when she arrived.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Sentí is the completed-past form of sentir for the speaker. The stem changes from sient- in siento to sent- in sentí.
In a social comparison, correcto can mean appropriate or acceptable rather than factually correct.

example.es: Fue la respuesta correcta para la ocasión.
example.en: It was the appropriate response for the occasion.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Hubo is the completed-past impersonal form of haber. It stays singular even when the thing mentioned afterward is plural.
Acorde con introduces the rule, evidence, or standard that something matches.

example.es: La decisión es acorde con las normas.
example.en: The decision is consistent with the rules.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: reference (in sistema de referencia, reference frame)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: In physics, referencia helps name the coordinate viewpoint from which motion is measured.

example.es: Elegimos un sistema de referencia fijo.
example.en: We chose a fixed reference frame.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Here señales are physical or electronic signals sent from one place or time to another, not signs that serve as evidence.

example.es: La antena envía señales de radio.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: to violate; to break (a rule or principle)

cardDefinitions.noteEn: In physics, causality is the principle that an effect cannot occur before the cause that produces it.

example.es: La teoría debe respetar la causalidad.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Cuántos carries a written accent in a direct or indirect question and changes to cuántas before a feminine plural noun.
With a short indirect word such as me, te, le, nos, or les, quedar can say what someone has left. The plural remaining thing controls quedan; one remaining thing uses queda.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: en el momento en que + hecho
cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you introduce something that happened at the exact moment another event occurred?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use en el momento en que, then state the event.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: En el momento en que acts as one time connector. En begins the time setting, el momento names the point, and en que links it to the event. The following verb changes normally for the person and time.

example.es: En el momento en que sonó el timbre, salimos.
example.en: The moment the bell rang, we left.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: acorde con + norma, plan o hecho
cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that something is consistent with a rule, plan, or fact?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use acorde con before the standard or information that it matches.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Acorde changes to acordes when it describes more than one thing; con remains fixed and introduces what provides the comparison.

example.es: Los datos son acordes con la predicción.
example.en: The data are consistent with the prediction.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: What is the standard Spanish term for the speed at which light travels?
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Velocidad names speed, and de la luz identifies light as what travels. The phrase is a conventional scientific term and can follow words such as medir, superar, or cerca de.

example.es: Nada viaja más rápido que la velocidad de la luz.
example.en: Nothing travels faster than the speed of light.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: What Spanish term names the viewpoint or coordinate system from which motion is measured?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use sistema de referencia; use sistemas de referencia for more than one.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: De referencia classifies the kind of sistema. In physics, changing the reference frame can change measured positions and velocities, while the noun sistema carries the singular or plural ending.

example.es: Medimos la velocidad desde otro sistema de referencia.
example.en: We measured the speed from another reference frame.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: Why is a physics discussion an especially inappropriate response to grief here?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: The joke contrasts the empathy a grieving person needs with physicists who become absorbed in a relativity puzzle about faster-than-light information.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Special relativity treats the speed of light as a limit for transmitted information. If a signal were instantaneous in one reference frame, another moving frame could order the events differently, threatening ordinary cause-before-effect causality. The escalating technical excitement ignores the human loss; the official title text extends the absurdity by imagining a way to exploit the discovery.

Abrasador is masculine singular to match masculine singular dolor.

applications.explanationEn: Acorde describes the delay as matching a physical limit, and con introduces that standard.
Acorde follows retraso and describes the delay before con introduces the standard it matches.
Acorde is singular to match singular retraso and has the same singular form with masculine and feminine nouns.
Velocidad names the speed, while de la luz identifies light as what travels.

applications.explanationEn: Sistemas is plural, de classifies their role, and referencia supplies the standard technical term.
Cuántos carries a written accent because it directly asks for a quantity.
Vivos follows hermanos in the common neutral order for a descriptive adjective.
Vivos uses masculine plural -os to match masculine plural hermanos.
Quedan is plural because hermanos vivos names more than one possible remaining person, while cuántos asks for the quantity.
